next.reason: 1985: "Within a declarative procedure, there must be no reference to any nondeclarative procedures."; 2023: "there shall be no reference to any nondeclarative procedures except in a RESUME statement.". Same prohibition, but 2023 adds a case: a declarative may refer to a nondeclarative procedure in a RESUME statement, which the 1985 rule forbids without exception.
